phantom.reference: Common pooled PICO and PMR reference

brain.configuration_note: systems entries in brain_pmr_configuration.json govern actual normalized lambdas; some arguments entries are stale historical CLI defaults.

CS.PICO: Explicit cached tangent propagation, batched 25 probes
CS.PMR: Sequential reconstructions, centered Welford M2/N population variance
CS.reported_map: Output standard deviation divided by input per-quadrature sigma
CS.probe: Independent real and imaginary signs; E|v|^2=2
CS.timing_scope: Implemented pipelines; cached/batched PICO versus sequential PMR. Both baseline construction and execution counted.
CS.reference_scope: No independent converged truth; method agreement at equal N.
CS.TV_limitation: Sensitivity/noise propagation targets the finite 30/50 iteration reconstruction algorithm.
